changeSet.comment: Convert sessions.issued_at from TIMESTAMP to TIMESTAMPTZ for OffsetDateTime support. This ensures consistency with orders.created_at and fixes timezone issues in KDS dashboard queries where session.issued_at is compared with reset times.
